dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and consistent geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle, forming an acute triangular profile.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear smooth and continuous without visible structural bulges or indentations at the water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with a uniform light-grey/blue tint; high median pixel intensity across the visible surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple low-contrast, fine linear striations distributed across the dorsal surface, consistent with healed rake marks.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent, dark longitudinal indentation is visible along the central dorsal axis, creating a distinct linear shadow cast by the dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Network of fine, superficial linear scars across the mid and posterior dorsal regions.
